_comment: A SNAPSHOT OF THE VOCABULARY THAT ACTUALLY OCCURS in the live wardrobe.
Not invented values — every string here was read from the owner's Supabase
rows on 2026-09-02. It exists because the test suite kept agreeing with the
code about words the owner does not use: 18 of her 61 subcategories appeared
in NO test, and 'Swimsuits' only arrived after a two-piece swimsuit rendered
as one piece in her hands.
Shapes and vocabulary only — no ids, no image URLs, no wear history.
Item names appear ONLY for Swim, where classification is name-driven
(swimPieceKind reads the name to tell a top from a bottom).
To refresh: npm run fixture:refresh (prints the SQL; paste the JSON back).
_tripItemStatusesNote: Only 'suggested' occurs live right now; 'packed' and 'left_behind' are the other two the code writes. All three must be exercised.
_blankProfileNote: Belts carry BOTH '' (11 rows) and null (3 rows) for subcategory. Any code that branches on subcategory must survive both, and the doctor flags the inconsistency.
_swimNamesNote: Every swim row is subcategory 'Swimsuits' — the two-piece/one-piece distinction lives ONLY in the name. This is why swimPieceKind is name-based and why these names are in the fixture.
_splitSetsNote: 8 coord sets have members in BOTH closets (the Never Better / Good Karma / In-Stride athleisure sets, bought in twos). Any 'what does this set contain' lookup against one closet returns half a set.
